name: Silver Spoon
description: Spoon-fed heroes: stats that grow every level and unlimited secondary skills.
author: An Bui

1.1.0: Level Scaling: land movement +10% per level (was +2%), new +100 sea movement points per level
Level Scaling: rough terrain costs 50 fewer movement points per tile
Level Scaling: a bonus is skipped for heroes whose specialty already gives the same bonus (previously only experience)
Level Scaling: every per-level bonus starts at level 2, so level 1 heroes keep their normal stats and abilities
1.0.0: Initial release: Level Scaling, Unlimited Secondary Skills
